appName.message: Dual Subtitles — Lingogram: belajar bahasa di YouTube & Netflix
appName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and the Web Store.

appDesc.message: Sarikata dwibahasa serentak di YouTube dan Netflix. Belajar bahasa Inggeris daripada tontonan anda, simpan perkataan sekali ketik.

ytOnboardingText.message: Pilih bahasa yang anda pelajari dan bahasa ibunda anda untuk bermula.
ytOnboardingText.description: Onboarding banner body asking the user to pick languages.

ytLearningLabel.description: Label for the "language I am learning" picker.

ytNativeLabel.description: Label for the "my native language" picker.

ytDownloadSubs.description: Label for the action that saves the main subtitle track as an .srt file. Used as the sidebar header button tooltip and as a row in the player menu.

ytDownloadEmpty.description: Tooltip on the download button while no subtitle track is loaded yet.

ytSelectPlaceholder.description: Placeholder option in a language dropdown.

ytLangGroupAvailable.description: Dropdown group heading for subtitle languages the current video offers.

ytLangGroupOther.description: Dropdown group heading for languages not available in the current video (shown disabled).

ytSearchingTitle.description: Status banner heading while looking for subtitles.

ytSearchingText.message: Mencari sari kata untuk video ini.
ytSearchingText.description: Status banner body while looking for subtitles.

ytNoSubsTitle.description: Status banner heading when a video has no subtitles.

ytNoSubsText.message: Video ini tiada sari kata. Cuba video lain — bukan semua video di YouTube mempunyai sari kata.
ytNoSubsText.description: Status banner body when a video has no subtitles.

ytSearchAgain.description: Retry button label on the no-subtitles banner.

ytReloadPage.description: Fallback button on the no-subtitles banner, shown after a retry still found no subtitles, that reloads the page.

ytNoSubsRetryText.message: Jika video ini ada sari kata tetapi kami tidak memaparkannya, muat semula halaman — ia selalunya membantu, dan kami akan menerima laporan untuk menyiasatnya.
ytNoSubsRetryText.description: Status banner body after a failed retry. Qualifies the emergency reload click ('video HAS subtitles, extension failed') so it doubles as a bug report to the admins, and discloses that a report is sent.

ytRateButton.description: Primary button on the rating prompt; opens the extension's Web Store review page.

ytRateQ.description: Step 1 of the rating prompt: asks whether the user likes the extension before any store link is offered.

ytRateQSub.message: Anda sudah menyimpan agak banyak perkataan.
ytRateQSub.description: Subtitle under the step-1 question of the rating prompt; reminds the user of the value they got.

ytRateStep2.message: Penilaian anda di Web Store amat bermakna bagi kami. Begitulah orang lain menemui kami.
ytRateStep2.description: Body of step 2 of the rating prompt: a gratitude-framed ask for a Web Store rating, shown only after the user said yes.

ytRateYes.description: Positive answer on step 1 of the rating prompt; leads to the star step.

ytRateNo.description: Negative answer on step 1 of the rating prompt; thanks the user and closes.

ytRateFeedbackTitle.description: Title of the feedback form shown after a negative answer on the rating prompt.

ytRateFeedbackHint.message: Apa yang tak kena? Apa anda ubah?

ytRateFeedbackSent.description: Confirmation shown briefly after feedback is sent, then the card closes.

ytRateFeedbackFailed.description: Error shown when sending feedback failed; the user can retry.

ytRateSkip.description: Dismiss button on the feedback form shown after a negative answer.

ytRateSend.description: Submit button on the feedback form.

ytRateSending.description: Submit button label while the feedback is in flight.

ytRateThanksYes.description: Title of step 2 of the rating prompt, acknowledging the user's positive answer.

ytRateLater.description: Dismiss button on the rating prompt.

ytStyleFontLabel.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontMonoSerif.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontPropSerif.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontMonoSans.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontPropSans.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontCasual.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontCursive.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytFontSmallCaps.description: CEA-708 font class name, matches YouTube's own caption settings.

ytStyleSizeLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay font-size slider (50-400%).

ytStyleColorLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay text-color swatches (main line).

ytStyleSubSizeLabel.description: Label for the translation-line font-size slider (50-400%), independent of the main line.

ytStyleSubColorLabel.description: Label for the translation-line text-color swatches, independent of the main line.

ytStyleTextOpacityLabel.description: Label for the subtitle text glyph-opacity presets (fades the letters, not the box behind them).

ytStyleCustomColor.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the custom-color well at the end of every color swatch row.

ytStyleBgColorLabel.description: Label for the subtitle caption-box background-color swatches.

ytStyleOffsetLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay vertical-position presets.

ytStyleBgLabel.description: Label for the subtitle overlay backdrop-opacity presets (how solid the caption box is, distinct from its color).

ytGroupLanguages.description: Settings panel group header for subtitle track language pickers.

ytGroupReadingMode.description: Settings panel group header for reading-mode toggles.

ytGroupText.description: Settings panel group header for subtitle text appearance: font, size, color.

ytGroupBox.description: Settings panel group header for the caption box and where it sits on the video.

ytModeSwap.description: Button that swaps the learning and native subtitle tracks.

ytModeDual.description: Toggle that shows both languages at once.

ytModeGuess.description: Toggle for the word-guessing practice mode.

ytModeOnScreen.description: Toggle that shows subtitles on the video itself.

ytBackdropOff.description: Backdrop opacity preset: no caption box at all, only the text.

ytStyleEdgeLabel.description: Label for the subtitle text edge-style presets.

ytEdgeNone.description: Edge style preset: no text shadow or outline.

ytEdgeShadow.description: Edge style preset: drop shadow behind the text.

ytEdgeOutline.description: Edge style preset: dark outline around each letter.

ytThemeLabel.description: Label for the panel theme presets (auto / light / dark).

ytThemeAuto.description: Theme preset: follow the operating system's light/dark setting.

ytThemeAutoTip.description: Tooltip for the Auto theme preset, explaining that it tracks the OS light/dark setting.

ytThemeLight.description: Theme preset: always use the light panel.

ytThemeDark.description: Theme preset: always use the dark panel.

ytStyleReset.description: Button that restores the default overlay appearance.

ytSettingsTitle.description: Sidebar header title while the settings panel is open.

ytMenuLabel.description: Accessible name of the menu opened from the button in YouTube's player controls.

ytMenuModes.description: Player-menu row that opens the reading-mode submenu; shows the current mode next to it.

ytMenuModeSingle.description: Reading mode: one subtitle line, no translation. Menu wording of the neither-dual-nor-guess state.

ytMenuModeDual.description: Reading mode: original and translation at once. Menu wording of ytModeDual, which is icon-sized.

ytMenuModeGuess.description: Reading mode: some words hidden until clicked. Menu wording of ytModeGuess, which is icon-sized.

ytMenuBack.description: Player-menu control returning from a submenu to the main list.

ytMenuOpenPanel.description: Player-menu row that expands the sidebar.

ytMenuHidePanel.description: Player-menu row that collapses the sidebar; replaces ytMenuOpenPanel while it is open.

ytMenuSettings.description: Player-menu row that opens the sidebar with the settings panel showing.

ytMenuOverlay.description: Player-menu toggle for the on-video subtitle overlay.

ytMenuChooseLanguages.description: Player-menu button shown before any languages are picked; opens the sidebar onboarding.

ytMenuNoSubtitles.message: Tiada sari kata untuk video ini
ytMenuNoSubtitles.description: Player-menu status line when no caption track was found. The line doubles as a retry button.

ytMenuNoTranslation.message: Tiada sari kata dalam bahasa anda, bahasa asal sahaja
ytMenuNoTranslation.description: Player-menu status line when the video is captioned in the language being learned but not in the user's native language. Informational, not an error: this is a normal outcome and there is nothing to retry.

ytTogglePanel.description: Accessible name of the tab at the screen edge that opens and closes the sidebar.

ytAuthSignInTitle.description: Heading of the sign-in popup opened from the account row above the subtitle list.

ytAuthSignInAction.description: Button that opens the Lingogram website to sign in. 'lingogram' is the product name.

ytAuthSignOut.description: Button that signs the user out of their Lingogram account.

ytAuthSignedIn.description: Fallback account-row text when the user is signed in but the email is unknown.

ytAuthSignedInAs.description: Label above the signed-in user's email address in the account panel.

ytAuthOpenFailed.message: Halaman log masuk tidak dapat dibuka. Cuba lagi.
ytAuthOpenFailed.description: Error shown when the browser could not open the Lingogram sign-in tab.

ytQuickAddSaved.description: Confirmation after a word is saved. {term} is the word the user selected and must be kept.

ytQuickAddNeedsSignIn.message: Log masuk melalui baris Lingogram di atas senarai sari kata untuk menyimpan perkataan.
ytQuickAddNeedsSignIn.description: Error shown when a word cannot be saved because the user is signed out.

ytQuickAddFailed.description: Error shown when saving a word failed. {error} is a technical message and must be kept.

ytQuickAddRemoveFailed.description: Error shown when taking a word off the saved list failed. {error} is a technical message and must be kept.

ytPopupLoading.description: Placeholder while the toolbar popup fetches the account status.

ytGuessRevealAria.message: Tunjukkan perkataan seterusnya sari kata ini
ytGuessRevealAria.description: Accessible label for the guess-mode subtitle line, which acts as a button.

ytModeSingle.description: Reading mode that shows only the original-language subtitles. Sits beside ytModeDual and ytModeGuess; keep it one short word.

ytThrottledTitle.description: Status banner heading when YouTube rate-limits (HTTP 429) the subtitle request. Distinct from the no-subtitles banner: the video HAS subtitles, YouTube just refused to serve them right now.

ytThrottledText.message: YouTube menyekat sementara permintaan sari kata untuk video ini. Ia adalah had di pihak mereka, bukan sari kata yang hilang — ia boleh hilang dalam beberapa minit, tetapi kadangkala berlarutan berjam-jam.
ytThrottledText.description: Status banner body for the rate-limited case. Must not imply the video lacks subtitles, and must not promise a recovery time — the limit has been observed to last hours.

ytRetryInSeconds.description: Disabled retry button label while the rate-limit cooldown runs. {s} is replaced in code with the remaining whole seconds.

ytLoadFailedTitle.description: Status banner heading when the signed subtitle URL expired or no token could be minted — recoverable by searching again.

ytLoadFailedText.message: Pautan sari kata telah tamat tempoh. Mencari semula biasanya menyelesaikan masalah ini.
ytLoadFailedText.description: Status banner body for the expired-link case.

ytLoadFailedRetryText.message: Mencari semula tidak membantu. Memuat semula halaman memperbaharui pautan sari kata dan biasanya menyelesaikan masalah ini.
ytLoadFailedRetryText.description: Status banner body after a failed manual retry on an expired subtitle link: the signed URL is cached in the page, so only a reload re-mints it.

ytDeferredTitle.description: Status banner heading on a Short whose search was deferred because the panel was closed. The catalogue says captions exist; nothing was downloaded yet.

ytDeferredText.message: Panel telah ditutup, jadi tiada apa-apa yang dimuat turun untuk video ini lagi.
ytDeferredText.description: Status banner body for the deferred-search case.

ytFindSubtitles.description: Button that starts the search that was deferred while the panel was closed.

ytMenuThrottled.message: Terjemahan dihadkan oleh YouTube — ketik untuk cuba lagi
ytMenuThrottled.description: Quiet player-menu status line when the translated track was rate-limited and a retry is available. The other track is playing normally, so this must not read as a failure of the whole extension.

ytMenuThrottledWait.message: Terjemahan dihadkan oleh YouTube — cuba lagi dalam {s} s
ytMenuThrottledWait.description: Quiet player-menu status line while the rate-limit cooldown runs. {s} is replaced in code with the remaining whole seconds.

ytPartialThrottled.description: Quiet one-line notice under the language chip when the translated track was rate-limited but another track is playing. Keep it short — it sits on one line beside a retry button.

ytPartialNotOffered.description: Quiet notice when YouTube simply has no machine translation for the chosen language. A normal outcome, not an error — nothing to retry.

ytPartialFailed.description: Quiet notice when the translated track failed to load for a recoverable reason other than rate limiting.

ytPartialThrottledHint.message: YouTube telah menghadkan sementara terjemahan automatik untuk anda. Ia adalah had mereka, bukan masalah sambungan — ia boleh hilang dalam beberapa minit, tetapi kadangkala berlarutan berjam-jam. Sari kata asal terus berfungsi sementara itu.
ytPartialThrottledHint.description: Hover explanation on the partial-failure row when YouTube rate-limited the translation. Honest about duration: minutes to hours, no promises. Reassures that the extension is not broken.

ytPartialNotOfferedHint.message: YouTube tidak menawarkan terjemahan automatik ke bahasa ini untuk video ini. Mencuba lagi tidak akan membantu — sari kata asal masih dipaparkan.
ytPartialNotOfferedHint.description: Hover explanation when YouTube has no machine translation for the chosen language. Says plainly that retrying is pointless, so the user stops trying.

ytPartialFailedHint.message: Pautan sari kata tamat tempoh sebelum terjemahan dimuatkan. Mencari semula biasanya menyelesaikan masalah ini.
ytPartialFailedHint.description: Hover explanation when the translated track failed for a recoverable reason other than rate limiting.

ytFeedbackCharsLeft.description: Byte-budget counter on the feedback form, shown only near the limit. {n} is replaced in code with the number remaining. It is aria-live, so the unit must be in the string — a bare number announces as meaningless.

ytFeedbackLink.description: Entry point at the bottom of the settings panel that opens the feedback screen.

ytFeedbackTitle.description: Sidebar header title while the feedback screen is open, replacing ytSettingsTitle.

ytFeedbackIntro.message: Beritahu kami apa yang rosak atau apa yang anda ingin ubah. Kami baca semuanya.
ytFeedbackIntro.description: One line of reassurance shown above the feedback message box.

ytFeedbackEmailLabel.description: Label above the optional email field on the feedback screen.

ytFeedbackEmailHint.message: E-mel (pilihan, hanya jika anda mahu balasan)
ytFeedbackEmailHint.description: Placeholder inside the optional email field, clarifying it's only needed for a reply.

ytFeedbackBackToSettings.description: Back chip on the feedback screen that returns to settings.

ytGroupPrivacy.description: Settings panel group header for the anonymous-usage-analytics opt-out toggle.

ytPrivacyAnalyticsLabel.description: Label for the checkbox that turns anonymous product analytics on or off. On by default.

ytNotificationClose.description: Accessible label and tooltip for the close button on the notification banner in the sidebar. Short imperative verb, like a close button on a dialog.

ytOverlayPreviewMain.description: Stand-in caption shown while positioning, when the video has no subtitle track.

ytOverlayPreviewSub.description: Stand-in translation line shown beneath the placeholder caption.

ytOverlayDragHandle.description: Tooltip/aria-label for the grip on the captions that drags them around the player.

ytOverlayCuePrev.description: Tooltip/aria-label for the ‹ button under the on-screen captions: jump back to the previous subtitle line.

ytOverlayCueReplay.description: Tooltip/aria-label for the ↺ button under the on-screen captions: play the current subtitle line again from its start.

ytOverlayCueNext.description: Tooltip/aria-label for the › button under the on-screen captions: jump to the next subtitle line.

ytLookupLoading.description: Hover strip / word screen: shown while the dictionary lookup is in flight.

ytLookupNone.description: Hover strip / word screen: the dictionary had nothing for this word (a name, a typo).

ytLookupError.description: Hover strip / word screen: the lookup request failed (network/timeout).

ytLookupSave.description: Heart button label: save the looked-up word to the dictionary.

ytLookupRemove.description: Label on a saved word’s heart: pressing it takes the word off the list.

ytLookupMore.description: Hover strip button that opens the sidebar word screen with the full entry.

ytLookupSrcDict.description: Word screen source badge: the answer came from the Wiktionary-based dictionary.

ytLookupSrcAi.description: Word screen source badge: the answer came from the language model.

ytPosNoun.description: Short part-of-speech label: noun. Keep it abbreviated — it renders as a small chip.

dupCopyTitle.description: Title of a banner in the subtitle panel: two installed copies of this extension are both enabled on the page.

dupCopyText.message: Dua salinan sambungan ini dihidupkan, jadi setiap perkataan disimpan dua kali dan satu daripada dua percubaan gagal dengan ralat. Matikan satu salinan dan muat semula halaman.
dupCopyText.description: Body of the 'running twice' banner: what goes wrong (every save is sent twice, one fails) and the way out (turn one copy off, reload).

dupCopyAction.description: Button on the 'running twice' banner: opens the other copy's page in chrome://extensions, where its on/off switch is.

ctxMenuSave.description: Right-click menu item shown on selected text on any website; saves the selection to the user's Lingogram word list. Keep the brand name Lingogram unchanged.

gtImportHint.message: Bawa frasa yang anda simpan dalam Google Terjemah ke dalam Lingogram.

gtImportRemoved.message: Pernah dipadam, tidak akan ditambah semula: {n}

gtImportProgress.message: Menyimpan {done} daripada {total}. Anda boleh menutup tetingkap ini.

gtImportFound.description: Google Translate import card, signed out: how many saved phrases were found on the page. {n} is a number.

gtImportSignInWhy.message: Log masuk dan frasa ini akan masuk ke dalam kosa kata Lingogram.
gtImportSignInWhy.description: Google Translate import card, signed out: the line under the count. 'them' = the saved phrases.

gtImportSignIn.description: Google Translate import card, signed out: the button that opens Lingogram sign-in.

gtImportErrNoList.message: Tiada frasa tersimpan ditemui. Buka translate.google.com, log masuk ke akaun Google anda dan semak senarai Disimpan.

gtImportErrDaily.message: Had harian dicapai. {done} daripada {total} telah disimpan; selebihnya boleh ditambah esok dengan mengimport semula.

gtImportErrGeneric.message: Sesuatu tidak kena. {done} daripada {total} telah disimpan. Cuba lagi.

gtImportPageButton.description: Button on translate.google.com that starts importing the saved phrases into Lingogram.

gtImportHide.description: Hides the import panel on translate.google.com; the import goes on.

ytSignInToKeepWords.message: Log masuk untuk menyimpan perkataan anda
ytSignInToKeepWords.description: Account prompt shown to a signed-out user in the subtitle panel and the player menu. Saving works without an account; signing in keeps the saved words on every device.

accountSignInOnLingogram.description: Button or link that opens the Lingogram website to sign in. 'Lingogram' is the product name.

accountSignInAgain.description: Button shown after the session expired; it opens the Lingogram website to sign in again.

popupEmptyTitle.description: Toolbar popup: title of the card shown while the learner has not saved any word yet.

popupEmptyText.message: Klik perkataan dalam sari kata, kemudian Simpan. Ia kekal di sini, dalam pelayar ini.
popupEmptyText.description: Toolbar popup: text of the card shown while the learner has not saved any word yet. 'Save' is the label of the save button on the word card.

popupMenuVocabulary.description: Toolbar popup: row that opens the learner's vocabulary on the Lingogram website, signed in. The number of saved words is shown at the right of the row.

popupMenuWaiting.description: Toolbar popup: row shown after the session expired; opens the extension's page with the words kept in this browser, waiting to be added to the account. The number of words is shown at the right of the row.

popupOpenVocabulary.description: Button that opens the learner's vocabulary on the Lingogram website.

popupSignInLead.description: Toolbar popup: link text. Followed by a space and the next string, so the two read as one sentence: 'Sign in to keep them on every device.'

popupSignInTail.message: – dan perkataan anda ada pada setiap peranti.
popupSignInTail.description: Toolbar popup: plain text after the 'Sign in' link; together they read as one sentence.

popupSignedOutNotice.message: Sesi tamat. Perkataan baharu disimpan pada peranti ini sehingga anda log masuk semula.
popupSignedOutNotice.description: Toolbar popup: notice shown when the session expired (the red '!' on the toolbar icon).

popupHighlightOnSite.description: Popup switch label for the current tab's site. {site} is the site's hostname without a leading 'www.' (for example en.wikipedia.org); it is replaced in code and not translated.

popupHighlightOffHere.description: Toolbar popup: line under the highlight row when highlighting is switched off for the current site. Followed by a space and the 'Manage sites' link, so the two read as one line.

popupManageSites.description: Toolbar popup: link that opens the extension's settings page at the list of sites where words are highlighted.

popupHighlightOffEverywhere.message: Penyerlahan dimatikan di semua laman web
popupHighlightOffEverywhere.description: Popup row text when highlighting is switched off for all websites; there is no switch then, only the 'Manage sites' link under it.

popupSettingsLink.description: Link in the toolbar popup, and on the My words page, that opens the settings.

settingsMyWords.description: Link in the settings page header to the page with the words saved in this browser.

wordsTitle.description: Title of the extension's page that lists the words saved in this browser.

wordsCount.description: My words page header: number of words. {count} is the number.

wordsSearchPlaceholder.description: My words page: placeholder and accessible name of the search field.

wordsRemove.description: My words page: button that removes one word from the list.

wordsRemoveFailed.message: Perkataan tidak dapat dialih keluar. Cuba lagi.
wordsRemoveFailed.description: My words page: short error shown under a word that could not be removed.

wordsLocalNoticeTitle.message: Perkataan ini hanya disimpan dalam pelayar ini.
wordsLocalNoticeTitle.description: My words page: title of the notice shown to a signed-out learner who has saved words.

wordsLocalNoticeText.message: Log masuk untuk memilikinya pada setiap peranti dan berlatih dengannya. Ia akan berpindah ke akaun anda secara automatik.
wordsLocalNoticeText.description: My words page: text of that notice. 'Practise' means doing the vocabulary exercises on the Lingogram website.

wordsAccountCard.message: Perkataan anda berada dalam kosa kata Lingogram anda.
wordsAccountCard.description: My words page: text of the card shown to a signed-in learner, next to the button that opens the vocabulary on the website.

wordsWaitingHeading.message: Menunggu untuk ditambah ke akaun anda
wordsWaitingHeading.description: My words page: small heading above words that were saved in this browser and are still waiting to be uploaded to the account.

wordsEmptyTitle.description: My words page: title shown when no word is saved.

wordsEmptyText.message: Klik perkataan dalam sari kata, kemudian Simpan. Perkataan yang anda simpan akan muncul di sini.
wordsEmptyText.description: My words page: text shown when no word is saved. 'Save' is the label of the save button on the word card.

ytAiStatusWorking.description: AI translation status: parts are being translated.

ytAiStatusReady.description: AI translation status: lines are arriving.

ytAiStatusAuth.message: Sign in again to use AI translation
ytAiStatusAuth.description: AI translation status: the sign-in must be renewed.

ytAiStatusQuota.message: Today's AI translation limit is reached
ytAiStatusQuota.description: AI translation status: the daily allowance is used up.

ytAiStatusLimit.message: Too many new videos today — try again later
ytAiStatusLimit.description: AI translation status: the daily limit of new videos is reached.

ytAiStatusUnavailable.description: AI translation status: the service cannot translate right now.

ytAiStatusRate.message: Too many requests — try again in a minute
ytAiStatusRate.description: AI translation status: the per-minute request limit is reached; it frees in a minute.

ytAiStatusTooLong.message: These subtitles are too long for AI translation
ytAiStatusTooLong.description: AI translation status: the track is too long to store for translation.

ytAiStatusUnsupported.message: AI translation does not cover this language pair
ytAiStatusUnsupported.description: AI translation status: the languages are not supported.
